description: Every outcome of one market with its implied probability, decimal odds and whether it is taking bets: a futures market (e.g. league winner), a side market on a match (exact score, half-time result) or a match itself. Pass a market_id from list_futures, find_matches or get_match_odds. Shows the winner once the market has settled.

limit.description: Most outcomes to return, likeliest first (1 to 40).

market_id.description: The market: an id from find_matches, list_futures or get_market, or a frontofgoal.com page URL.

name: get_market

kickoff_or_close.description: Kickoff for a match, or when a futures market settles at the latest; ISO 8601 UTC.

outcome.description: The outcome, e.g. a team, a player or Yes.

quoted.description: True when a bid and an ask are standing.

trading.description: True while the market takes bets.

prices_live.description: True when the prices were read live for this answer.

traded_30d_usd.description: US dollars traded in the last 30 days.

title: Get market odds
